items.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
items.summary:
Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.Auto Ontology 
Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how

confirmed_facts.text: NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API.

confirmed_facts.text: It complements the semantic models customers already own.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: It complements the semantic models customers already own.

confirmed_facts.text: It enables developers to: - Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI-ready knowledge graphs.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: It enables developers to: - Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI-ready knowledge graphs.

confirmed_facts.text: - Ground: give agents trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships; reconcile inconsistent definitions across systems.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: - Ground: give agents trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships; reconcile inconsistent definitions across systems.

confirmed_facts.text: - Validate: check generated queries against certified definitions and lineage; return provenance with every answer.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: - Validate: check generated queries against certified definitions and lineage; return provenance with every answer.

confirmed_facts.text: - Natural-language querying of structured data — questions are translated to SQL and executed against connected databases, powered by NVIDIA NIM.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: - Natural-language querying of structured data — questions are translated to SQL and executed against connected databases, powered by NVIDIA NIM.
